anchor.quote: Each type maps to a specific hormone your body over-produces

claims.rationale: A one-to-one Enneagram-type-to-hormone overproduction relationship is externally testable, but no population, assay, source, uncertainty, or model boundary is supplied at the strength claimed.

legacy.quote: "Each type maps to a specific hormone your body over-produces"

legacy.quote: "activates at 300 milliseconds, before your 800-millisecond narrative has loaded"

claims.rationale: A trigger log can show present recurrence, but it cannot by itself establish the historical threat that originally calibrated a nervous system; the etiological inference needs causal evidence or narrower model framing.

legacy.quote: "what your nervous system was originally calibrated to detect"
